name: SCREENING_FORMS
description: Candidate intake forms as data (fields, validation, consent notice with version and retention), a stdlib proof-of-work challenge against spam, upload limits with file-type sniffing, hashed expiring candidate tokens for status and withdrawal pages, and the staff side: accept or discard pending submissions into ATS_CORE. The public intake logic is plain functions for a gateway; candidates are not Callers and nothing public is in the identity-authenticated API.

harness.purpose: SCREENING_FORMS: intake forms and the staff side of candidate intake.
